summary: Gorax showcases a massive summoning session chasing Inspiration 5 on Child of Chaos after getting early pull luck. Although Inspiration 3 grants a 30% attack boost that works well in PvP and Fey Meander, he felt compelled to push all the way to Inspiration 5 for optimal PvE performance. He warns players against making the same mistake and falling for the temptation to over-pull. Instead, he advises saving summoning resources for higher-priority banners like the upcoming Aura banner, Anneliesis, and Wish Summons.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.verdict: Requires heavy investment for peak PvE performance
heroes.note: Inspiration 3 gives a 30% Attack boost suitable for PvP and Fey Meander, but Inspiration 5 is targeted for optimal PvE value.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Gorax recommends saving dice specifically for her banner and the upcoming Aura hero banner.

tips: Do not get baited into chasing high Inspiration levels just because you pulled an early copy of a hero.
Save Heliolite Dice for high-priority targets like the upcoming Aura hero, Anneliesis, or Wish Summons rather than over-investing in single banners.
Inspiration 3 provides a 30% Attack increase, which is solid for PvP and Fey Meander if you choose to stop early.
title: I Got Baited Into Pulling MORE on Child of Chaos… | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
